title: Chapter 620
paragraphs: Chapter 620
Episode 159. The King's Competition (7)
"Are we really going to keep doing this?"
"What made Jin like this?"

"Is it really enough to infuriate him that much when he said he needs to be reevaluated even though he's already become the successor to the Tosin brothers? Enough to attack his own brothers! If Jin truly considers the situations his brothers have been through, he should be able to understand it."
"Moreover, not all brothers insisted that Jin should be reevaluated. Even the Twelfth King brothers just wanted a fair King's Competition, they didn't have an attitude to take away what Jin has."
"Say something!"
As Baba said, even though the Myungwang tribe was so angry, they still didn't have the courage to kill or exile Jin sincerely.
They talked as if they would oust Jin from Kaiyo's sickroom at any moment, but what they wanted most was a conversation with Jin.
The Myungwang tribe's rule that brothers don't keep score with each other was still valid for Jin.
But Jin was making the situation worse.
The Myungwang tribe was ready to forgive him if he made a sincere apology, but Jin coldly turned away all the brothers who came to him.
As the days went by, the Myungwang tribe's disappointment deepened. Looking at Jin, who was endlessly cold, selfish, and rational, they began to wonder if the person they knew ever existed.
"All the behaviors he has shown so far were fake. How can a person change in a moment like this? We were willing to give everything!"

"If he had honestly talked once, that he has already succeeded Sigmund so there's no need for more validation, would we have ignored him? The Twelfth King brothers, of course, and all the brothers would have accepted it."

"He seemed convinced that we were creating a fuss to take his things. He must have hated giving his brothers an equal opportunity as a brother. 'How dare these people, who can't go out without me, try to verify my qualifications now?' It's this kind of attitude."
"He was never meant to become a real Myungwang. After all, he is a human, always immersed in greed, that race!"
Regret turned into anger, and anger soon transformed into a feeling close to hatred. It was an unforeseen problem that such a deep gap could form in their relationship in a moment.
77 people, 78 including Jin, 79 including Lingling.
The city filled with gold radiating old glory and dignity always exuded a vibrant and shining atmosphere with even that small number every time Jin came, but now it was full of tense silence.
"Hoo."
Jin spent his time in the vacant houses on the outskirts of Laprarosa, away from the Tosin competition.
Even when the King's Competition was happening, he didn't visit the main hall if it wasn't his competition.
'I've felt it since last time, but this is really a mess.'
He was not at ease.
Even when he provoked Caio, cruelly pricked him, and even now as he continues to agitate all his brothers. Of course, it felt bitter and painful in his chest, as if it was filled with rust.
However, the more serious the situation became, the more certain he was that it was a process that must be passed at least once.
'I should not leave any impression that my succession of Sigmund is a reward that I obtained for nothing.'
Hierarchy.
Apart from the god of fight, all the Myungwang clan are equal. But looking back, Jin was always in an exceptional position.
He mastered the Myungwang sword even though he was not a brother, and as soon as he became a brother, he immediately succeeded Sigmund.
So, when he lined up, Jin's position was next to Ban, and in the opening game, he fought with all the Myungwang clan through the fusion of gods.
Before all these events happened, the time they spent together was only a few years.
They have never fought a life-and-death battle with their backs trusted, nor have they defended territory, conquered, slaughtered enemies, or participated in a war of destiny.
Jin has always received from this place. However, as Tantel said, the Myungwang clan are also humans, so there are extremely ordinary emotions.
Even after the Myungwang clan accepted Jin as a brother, and even after Jin had a rank next to Ban, they always considered Jin as someone they had to 'take care of.'

They couldn't help but want to treat him completely equally. The Myungwang clan are in a god-like state trapped in a dead world, and the time they spent with Jin is extremely short. In other words, the Myungwang clan treated Jin only as a younger brother.
As a Myungwang clan brother with the second rank, Jin.
He thought that he should not be an object of consideration to them, but an object of struggle. Not just as a weak person, but as an equal, and an object that needs to surpass equality.
If he could show it with transcendent power like Ban, or if he had enough time, there would have been no need to provoke conflict as he does now.
The same was true even if the Myungwang clan were still trapped in Lafrarosa. There would have been no problem at all, being loved as the youngest, and only receiving, without any conflicts forever.
But if he wanted to fight with his brothers outside, and to control them as a leader in the future.
A real fight was definitely needed. Not a play that is close to reality, but a real fight.
It was necessary to confirm what remains after that fight.
It's not that he's not worried at all because he's Jin. There is no guarantee that the result obtained at the end of the fight will always be good.
'Clear your mind. Until the Tuwangdaejun is over, all you have to do is focus on training.'
Meditation and review.
After waking up, Jin has been growing all the time except for the Daedun.
The injury he got from the Daedun with Caio stimulated the sense of god fusion more strongly, and Jin's training was carried out at a level higher than what he had done before.

The optimal path to prick and cut the target, the coolness that is maintained in any situation, the sense of avoiding death, and some landscapes that are estimated to be the area where people who seemed endlessly distant and like a huge mountain were looking at....
For example, a world of dance that only transcended beings can know.
Images of that world were constantly being drawn in his mind. Jin was surprisingly quick to take it all in, thanks in part to Ban's sensory experience through the fusion of the gods.
But that was not all.
'The sensation of the God's brothers is that of a person who was a strong man from the moment of birth. Just like a father.'
Jin's own domain was being added to that sensation.
The unique domain of Jin Runkandel, a warrior who has gone through the bottom and long despair and even death, colored the transcendent world more vividly.
As a result.
In the 31st match held three days later, Jin directly broke through Nata, the eleven king.
Nata was full of poison, and a fierce battle ensued, but in the end, Jin was the winner.
'Did you mean you didn't use all your power when you fought with the Ten Kings?'
'No, he's stronger. In that short time.'

'Hmm, Jin must have known exactly how fast he was growing. So he crossed the line and became arrogant. There was no such thought as the privilege gained through the fusion of the gods and succession.'
In the following 38th match, he lost to Belize. However, Belize was threatened with death with her right arm cut off, and Jin did not stop there as he had warned her in advance.
"This…!"
Just like with Kaio, he thrust his sword into her throat one more time after the victory or defeat was decided.

The Ming Royal Family was watching Jin more than before, so fortunately, his sword did not hit Belize's neck, nor did Belize counterattack and Jin died. The Ming Royal Family fired a brain war to separate the two.
Jin's limbs were twisted in the process, and Belize was not hurt. Now, the Ming Royal Family had no hesitation in aggressively suppressing Jin.
The anger towards Jin was even more amplified.
"Crazy... you really want to kill your brothers again."
"The Seven Kings brothers defended Jin until this morning. Now the Seven Kings brothers must have changed their minds."
After Jin's recovery was over, he defeated Garmund in the 46th match, and in the 50th and 54th matches, he suffered defeats to Baltirok and Lumora, respectively.
Every time he lost, he rushed to the end like a demon and was suppressed. No one was surprised at his appearance now.
Jin's body was gradually becoming emaciated.
Even if it was a body blessed by Runkandel, he could not keep going as he was recovering and fighting to the limit with the Kings.
Other Ming Royal Family members were also accumulating damage, but Jin was fighting a completely different battle from them.
It was full of malice and hatred that could not be found in the other Ming Royal Family's competitions.
Those dark energies were eating Jin like a fungus.
"I can't... fight."
In the 60th competition, Linfa, who was pitted against Jin, said so as soon as the competition began.
She didn't have the courage to fight with Jin, who was battered. The Ming Royal Family members all respected her decision.
Linfa was a character who had silenced herself with guilt for failing to stop her brothers from challenging the gods to the end.
'After all, the next competition is with the nine kings brothers.'
'No matter how quickly you become stronger, you can never beat the nine kings brothers. Since they are already losing to other kings brothers...'
'In the end, the Baba brothers will end it. Even the Baba brothers, who have been tolerating Jin's rampage so far, are shaking now.'
Baba, like Belize, was a character who did not give up hope for Jin to the end.
She was still ready to forgive Jin if he reached out.
She was hoping that Jin would not go further, deeper and darker, where he could not return.
"You won't fight me?"
Linfa nodded and turned at the cold voice of Jin.
"That's right..."
"I warn you, Linfa. If you move a step from there, you'll be cut right there. Don't avoid the fight."
Linfa moved her steps without hesitation, and Jin.
He cut her back with a spirit sword.
It was shallow because Linfa reacted, but a long cut remained. A splash of red blood splattered.
The bloody mark, which seemed to cut the red lines, seemed to symbolize that the relationship between the Ming Royal Family and Jin had reached the end.
"Sa, Sa king brothers!"
"That crazy guy again...!"
Ban showed a gesture of restraining the Ming Royal Family members who were trying to rush in with one hand.
"He hasn't broken the rules yet. If Jin brothers kill Sa king brothers, I'll handle it myself. Will you continue, Sa king brothers?"
"...I will stop."
Silence flowed. Jin looked down at the fallen Linfa, and when Ban's declaration of the end of the competition fell, he turned away indifferently.
And at the moment when Jin was about to get out of the main hall, Baba suddenly moved her steps to the center of the main hall and opened her mouth.
"God's brothers."
"Speak, nine king brothers."
"Just now, the God's brothers referred to Jin as a brother, but we can no longer consider him as a brother."
"What do you want to say?"
Baba glared at Jin's back and said this.
"So can I kill Jin Runkandel in the next competition?"
